transcript.text: I need to share critical information from the blood bank. This patient has documented antibodies against common platelet antigens. Because of this, the blood bank has reserved a compatible HLA-selected, irradiated single-donor platelet unit specifically for this patient. This specialized product is reserved only until 22:00, and it must be picked up from the blood bank by 20:30 in order to preserve the planned transfusion start time. Given Dr. Chen's clinical context of active bleeding and a platelet count of 7,000, I strongly recommend we proceed with this HLA-selected product rather than a standard pooled platelet product, as the patient's antibodies would likely make standard platelets ineffective.
